Overall structure
The scene is built on a symmetrical vertical axis running down the center of the screen. The central column is the action zone (grid + stake + execute), flanked by two equal side panels (Spins ↔ Items), with a top bar that mirrors left-to-right (meta icons ↔ goal).

Top-right GOAL box — mirrors the meta box exactly: 78%–98% horizontal, 2%–13% vertical. Same dimensions, same border treatment. Contains the word GOAL (or the current goal value/icon) centered.
Center bankroll readout — between the two boxes, centered on the vertical axis at roughly 40%–60% horizontal, 3%–10% vertical. Displays the bankroll as X/Y (e.g. 10/10). No border — floating text, large.

+ button (right, ~54%–58% horizontal)

Main play area — 22% to 88% vertical
Three vertical columns, mirrored around the center.

Tall vertical rectangle.

Charge meter — the bottom row of the grid, 22%–76% horizontal, sitting at roughly 66%–72% vertical. Visually distinct (filled/shaded) and shows fill progress horizontally left-to-right. When full, it triggers a free bonus execute.
Multiplier readout — centered below the grid, 40%–60% horizontal, 73%–78% vertical. Displays the current potential multiplier (e.g. 99999x). Large text, no border.
EXECUTE button — centered below the multiplier, 35%–65% horizontal, 80%–87% vertical. Wider than the stake selector, clearly the primary action. Rectangular with rounded corners.

Bottom margin — 88% to 100% vertical
Empty breathing room. No UI elements. Ensures the EXECUTE button isn't flush against the screen edge.

Symmetry rules (non-negotiable)

Vertical axis at 50% horizontal is a mirror line. Anything left of it has a counterpart right of it at the same distance from the axis.
Meta box (top-left) and GOAL box (top-right) are identical dimensions.
SPINS panel and ITEMS panel are identical dimensions and styling; only the label and content differ.
Stake − and + buttons are mirror-symmetrical.
The bankroll readout, stake selector, grid, charge meter, multiplier, and EXECUTE button are all centered on the vertical axis.

Top bar: 15% of height
Stake selector: 7% of height
Grid + charge meter: 50% of height
Multiplier: 5% of height
EXECUTE: 7% of height
Bottom margin: 12% of height

The grid (largest single element, center of attention)
EXECUTE button (primary action)

func _discover_available_items() -> Array:
	var found: Array = []
	var dir := DirAccess.open("res://combat/data/items")
	if dir == null:
		return found
	dir.list_dir_begin()
	var file_name := dir.get_next()
	while file_name != "":
		if file_name.ends_with(".tres") or file_name.ends_with(".res"):
			var res := load("res://combat/data/items/".path_join(file_name))
			if res != null and res is ItemDefScript:
				found.append(res)
		file_name = dir.get_next()
	dir.list_dir_end()
	found.sort_custom(func(a, b): return String(a.id) < String(b.id))
	return found

	file.close()
